FETCHED: 2026-06-17
LAST UPDATED: 2024-08-26
PART OF: Spark UI Guide series (linked from long-spark-stage when task count = 1)
NOTE: List-only page — six causes named with no per-cause explanation or remediation.

=== CORE PROBLEM ===
"If you see a long-running stage with just one task, that's likely a sign of a problem. While this one task is running only one CPU is utilized and the rest of the cluster may be idle."

=== SIX CAUSES ===
1. Expensive UDF on small data
2. Window function without PARTITION BY statement
3. Reading from an unsplittable file type (e.g. Gzip)
4. Setting the multiLine option when reading a JSON or CSV file
5. Schema inference of a large file
6. Use of repartition(1) or coalesce(1)
